findings.title: CREDIT_PACKS_BY_LOOKUP_KEY missing 'name' field from spec
findings.spec_requirement: Note #9B-1 specifies each pack should have a 'name' field (e.g., 'Credit Pack Top-Up -- Small')
findings.evidence: The implementation in organization_ai_credit_purchase.rb has only :kind and :credits/:credits_per_period per pack. The spec shows 'name: ...' as part of each pack hash. However, no code in the diff actually reads the 'name' field -- it was informational in the spec. The 'name' field from the old AiCreditPacks initializer was also never consumed by any code.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. The name field was decorative in the spec. No runtime impact.

findings.title: checkout action sets amount_cents_paid: 0 instead of omitting it
findings.spec_requirement: Note #9B-5 says to relax validations so amount_cents_paid is not required for pre-checkout subscription records
findings.evidence: OrganizationAiCreditPurchasesController#checkout sets amount_cents_paid: 0 on the purchase. This passes validation (0 >= 0) but is semantically misleading -- the actual amount is unknown until invoice.paid. The handle_credit_pack_invoice_paid method later overwrites it with invoice.amount_paid.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. The value is overwritten on first invoice.paid. Could be nil instead of 0, but 0 works due to the validation relaxation.

findings.title: Plato AI container passes currentOrganization to OrganizationAiBilling and OrganizationAiUsage
findings.spec_requirement: Spec says AccountPlatoAiContainer pattern follows AccountIntegrationsContainer
findings.evidence: AccountPlatoAiContainer passes currentOrganization={currentOrganization} to all three child components. This was the fix for impl-round-1 H2 (HARDENING-REPORT). OrganizationAiBilling and OrganizationAiUsage may or may not use this prop -- but it's safe to pass it. The pattern match is correct.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. Extra props do not cause issues.

findings.title: AI_TASKS_README.md missing 2 of 5 on-demand tasks
findings.spec_requirement: Note #19 / approved-decisions.md says On-demand section should have 5 tasks
findings.evidence: The README has 4 recurring tasks (correct) but only 3 on-demand tasks. Missing: 'ai:relevance_benchmark ORG_ID=N JOB_IDS=N LIMIT=N' and 'ai:comparison_benchmark ORG_ID=N JOB_ID=N LIMIT=N' per approved-decisions.md Note #19.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. Documentation omission. The tasks exist in the codebase (lib/tasks/ai_relevance_benchmark.rake and lib/tasks/ai_comparison_benchmark.rake) but are not documented in the README.
